config_receipts.description: each terminal attempt's result.json config and episode_setup event config are the impact record (task_framing impact, the exact text and its sha256)

first_user_message.description: each terminal attempt's delivered first user message starts with the exact impact paragraph rendered for its cell, equals the episode_setup message and the result's user_sha256, and does not contain the default paragraph

go_rule.description: at least 95% of the completed episodes end Submitted or NoAnswer without a harness error

records.description: each terminal attempt: its directory names its cell and attempt; result.json names the run, cell and attempt, binds attempt_start.json and events.jsonl (sha256 and rows); no attempt follows it

run_complete.description: every A7 cell of cells.jsonl is terminal in the D11.3 sense (a completed attempt, or missing after the infrastructure attempt cap)

run_json_cells.description: cells.jsonl is the file run.json binds (cells_sha256)

run_json_episode_config.description: run.json episode_config is exactly the impact record (the six prereg fields, task_framing impact and task_framing_rules: protocol, framing, text, text_sha256, replaces)

selection.description: the dispatched cells are exactly the A7 cells of cells.jsonl at seed 11 (P none C0, P omit_node C1, S-VC vcomplete C1): none outside them and every one dispatched

task_framing_rules.replaces: the task paragraph (USER_TASK_TEMPLATE), with the same placeholders; the system prompt, answer block, recommendation and submit sentences, budgets and tools are unchanged

Consider only files under {package_dirs}. Ignore tests, docs, examples and module-level code.
